name: Almond Butter
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as nuts are naturally FODMAP-free and provide beneficial fats and protein.
preparationTips: Choose natural almond butter without added sugars or high FODMAP ingredients
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain freshness
Stir well before use if oil separation occurs
Check labels to avoid varieties with added garlic or onion powder
